rationale: At least four maximum-length blocks before paired interval screening; require multiple disjoint positive label intervals. No fixed sample size alone guarantees independence or power.
acceptance: Point gates plus precision-delta lower bound >0 and recall-delta lower bound >-.05 for both block lengths. Passing is eligible for review, never automatic deployment.
external_condition: Only real same-session predictions after runtime freeze count. Future outcomes need 20 subsequent trading sessions; meaningful validation may need substantially longer.
